verdict.rationale: Helicone documents a built-in dashboard that tracks usage, costs and performance across providers. Its paid tier adds HQL, a query language, and a community report describes users writing SQL directly against ClickHouse, which supports ad-hoc analysis over logged metrics. The GitHub README's 'custom dashboards' claim depends on a one-line export to PostHog, so the custom dashboard building happens in an external tool rather than in Helicone itself. missing for 10: a native, user-configurable custom dashboard builder documented in Helicone, eval-score metrics surfaced in dashboards, explicit latency/error charting configuration, and independent hands-on corroboration of custom dashboard creation.
